# given name

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:namePartGiven`](gmeow-namePartGiven.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/namePartGiven>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

The given name part type — a kind of component that can appear in a personal or organizational appellation.

**Types:** [`gmeow:NamePartType`](../classes/gmeow-NamePartType.md)
